mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, archived, archived_file, archived_attachxxx_file, archived_user_id, archived_time, gmt_created, group_type FROM tb_group_extends WHERE group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT tge.id, tcg.owner_id as user_id, tge.group_id, tcg.group_name as groupName,tge.archived,tcg.avatar_img as avatarImg, tcg.create_time as gmtCreated, COALESCE(tag_agg.tags, '') as tagName,tge.archived_time, MAX(CASE WHEN tgc.user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )AS is_care, tge.group_type as groupType, tcg.owner_id as ownerId, tcg.user_ids as members, tge.archived_user_id as archivedUserId FROM tb_group_extends tge LEFT JOIN tb_group_care tgc ON tge.group_id = tgc.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_create_group tcg ON tge.group_id = tcg.group_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tag.name SEPARATOR ',') as tags FROM tb_group_tag tgt LEFT JOIN tb_label tag ON tgt.tag_id = tag.id WHERE tgt.group_id = tge.group_id AND tgt.is_deleted = 0 ) tag_agg ON TRUE
AND ( tcg.user_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR tcg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tcg.create_time, '%Y/%m/%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tcg.create_time, '%Y/%c/%e') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tge.archived_time, '%Y/%m/%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tge.archived_time, '%Y/%c/%e') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR tcg.department_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_tasks_group ttg LEFT JOIN tb_tasks tt ON ttg.task_id = tt.id WHERE ttg.group_id = tge.group_id AND tt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_police_ticket_group tptg LEFT JOIN tb_police_ticket tpt ON tptg.ticket_id = tpt.id WHERE tptg.group_id = tge.group_id AND tpt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%')) )
AND tge.group_type = #{groupType}
AND tge.archived = 2
AND tge.archived in (0, 1)
AND tge.archived_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{archivedTime}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND tge.archived_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{archivedTime}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tagName}, tag_agg.tags) > 0
AND tcg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{groupName}, '%')
AND ( tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%')
OR
tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{postId}, '%')
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_collaboration_post_group tcpg WHERE tcpg.group_id = tge.group_id AND tcpg.support_user_id = #{userId}) )
AND tcg.department_id IN
#{orgId}
AND tcg.owner_id = #{userId}
AND ( tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%')
OR
tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{postId}, '%')
)
AND tcg.user_ids NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%')
AND
tcg.user_ids NOT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{postId}, '%')
AND tcg.owner_id != #{userId}
GROUP BY tge.id, tcg.owner_id, tge.group_id,tag_agg.tags , tcg.group_name, tge.archived, tcg.avatar_img, tcg.create_time, tge.archived_time,tge.group_type,tge.archived_user_id ORDER BY
tge.archived_time DESC, tcg.create_time DESC
tcg.create_time DESC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(tge.archived_time), '-',LPAD(MONTH(tge.archived_time), 2, '0')) AS yearMonth, COUNT(DISTINCT tge.group_id) AS count FROM tb_group_extends tge LEFT JOIN tb_create_group tcg ON tge.group_id = tcg.group_id WHERE tge.archived = 2
AND ( tcg.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR tcg.user_names LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tcg.create_time, '%Y/%m/%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tcg.create_time, '%Y/%c/%e') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tge.archived_time, '%Y/%m/%d') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR DATE_FORMAT(tge.archived_time, '%Y/%c/%e') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR tcg.department_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_tasks_group ttg LEFT JOIN tb_tasks tt ON ttg.task_id = tt.id WHERE ttg.group_id = tge.group_id AND tt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%')) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tr_police_ticket_group tptg LEFT JOIN tb_police_ticket tpt ON tptg.ticket_id = tpt.id WHERE tptg.group_id = tge.group_id AND tpt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%')) )
AND ( tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userId}, '%')
OR
tcg.user_ids LIKE CONCAT('%', #{postId}, '%')
)
AND tcg.department_id IN
#{orgId}
AND archived_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY yearMonth ORDER BY yearMonth DESC

select tge.group_id as groupId, tcg.group_name as groupName, COALESCE(tag_agg.tags, '') as tagName, tcg.department_name as departmentName, tge.archived_time as archivedTime, tge.archived_file as archivedFile, CONCAT( COALESCE(agg.ticket_names, ''), CASE WHEN agg.task_names IS NOT NULL AND agg.ticket_names IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END, COALESCE(agg.task_names, '') ) as taskName, tiu.name as archiveUserName from tb_group_extends tge left join tb_create_group tcg on tge.group_id = tcg.group_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tt.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM tr_tasks_group ttg JOIN tb_tasks tt ON ttg.task_id = tt.id WHERE ttg.group_id = tge.group_id) AS task_names, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tpt.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM tr_police_ticket_group tptg JOIN tb_police_ticket tpt ON tptg.ticket_id = tpt.id WHERE tptg.group_id = tge.group_id) AS ticket_names ) agg ON TRUE left join icp_res.tb_im_user tiu on tge.archived_user_id = tiu.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tag.name SEPARATOR ',') as tags FROM tb_group_tag tgt LEFT JOIN tb_label tag ON tgt.tag_id = tag.id WHERE tgt.group_id = tge.group_id AND tgt.is_deleted = 0 ) tag_agg ON TRUE
tge.archived = 2
and tge.archived_time >= #{startTime}
and tge.archived_time <= CONCAT(#{endTime}, ' 23:59:59')
and ( tag_agg.tags like concat('%',#{keywords},'%') or tcg.group_name like concat('%',#{keywords},'%') or tcg.department_name like concat('%',#{keywords},'%') )
GROUP BY tge.group_id, tcg.group_name, tag_agg.tags, tcg.department_name, tge.archived_time, tge.archived_file, tiu.name, agg.task_names, agg.ticket_names ORDER BY tge.archived_time DESC
